about: A Node.js and browser library that reads tags, format details and duration from audio and video files.

prs.title: Mono AAC files from Apple apps now report one channel
prs.broken: Voice memos and audiobooks from Apple encoders were reported as stereo, because the library trusted a channel count that is usually left at two.
prs.changed: For common AAC audio the channel count now comes from the codec settings inside the file, as the standard defines.
prs.matters: Apps that show or convert audio get the real channel count, matching ffprobe.

prs.title: Album, date, composer and disc tags in Matroska files are now read
prs.broken: Matroska and WebM files that store album, album artist, composer, date or disc as plain track tags showed none of them in the common metadata.
prs.changed: Those tag names now fill the matching common fields.
prs.matters: Music players and taggers see the album details these files already carry.
